node.statement: Every simplex of K is, by definition, a nonempty finite subset of the vertex set V (and K is a family of such subsets closed under nonempty subsets). If V has N vertices, its power set has exactly 2^N members. Since K is a subfamily of that finite power set, K has at most 2^N simplices and is therefore a finite simplicial complex.
